narrative_prose: Hector braced against the howling wind as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea tore the horizon into violent, jagged peaks of black liquid metal. He tasted the sharp tang of ozone, the heavy scent of burning copper insulation assaulting his nose, while the deafening roar of the shear wave drowned out all other sound. Blinding violet arcs and shimmering metallic waves illuminated the darkness, forcing him to quickly CONCEAL the expedition baton within the trench to DEFEND it from the surging magnetic field. Surging forward against the magnetic resistance, he waved a flare to ATTRACT Kaio's attention, lunging toward his squadmate to complete the handoff.
summary: Hector battles the magnetohydrodynamic shear wave to hand off the baton to Kaio at the ferrofluid sea outpost.
